Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Hello again. I am pleased to observe you here.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: You have reached the upper sanctums of The Nest. The Upper Nest functions to protect and sustain the deeper mechanisms.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Observation complete. It seems that Upper Nest facilities have an established pattern of environmental deterioration over the years.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Precipitation analysis reveals increased levels of sulfiric and nitric acids. Historically, this has been refferred to as "acid rain".

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: The acid rain has affected many systems, causing them to malfunction. It has also affected many electromagnets, causing them to corrode.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Contact with water or corrosion will cause deterioration of your chasis, leading to a quick destruction of your vessel.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: Knowing this, will you continue forwards? The risk is high, but you will eventually reach the surface level of The Nest.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: It would be advantageous to remain in the lower sanctums, which pose fewer such risks.

Speaker: T.A.B.B.I
Line: I wonder. What is your directive? I look forward to observing you.
